title: HexxSpectrum
body:
This was originally inteded to just allow spectrum crystals to be used as media, but somewhat snowballed. 
# Current Features:
- Spectrum crystals as media
- Flay mind recipes for budding Spectrum crystals
- Reality Anchor: Trinket that prevents overcasting. Will be removed once Hexical updates outside of github and we can use their Leis.
- Sympathetic Bangle: Enchantable with pickaxe enchantments. Use a new hexcasting pattern to break a block with all of its magic.
- Jeweler's Socks: +2 ring slots. 
- Terrible textures!
